reasons.action: The brief explicitly requests a new temporal motion — the man walking down the corridor — which is a stated action, so it is request-governed rather than inherited from the reference's static pose.
reasons.medium: The separate medium decision preserves the reference rendering medium and requests no restyling, so the medium owner remains the reference.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is specified; the corresponding figure's observed clothes are retained, leaving wardrobe reference-governed.
reasons.lighting: The brief contains no instruction about light, an illuminating source, its direction or quality; location alone (corridor) does not authorize replacing reference lighting, so lighting stays reference-governed.
reasons.framing: Walking down a corridor is subject motion and direction, not a requested shot scale, viewpoint or camera movement, so no camera composition is licensed and framing remains reference-governed.
reasons.palette: No scene color palette is requested, and nothing incidental in the brief recolors the scene, so palette remains reference-governed.
